record.question: In analog computer
options: Input is first converted to digital form
Input is never converted to digital form
Output is displayed in digital form
record.explanation: An analog computer processes continuously varying physical quantities directly, so its input is never converted to digital form (option B). The printed question on PDF page 1 of the 2016 Paper I is clear and the options are complete.
